BiblicalUsage: Abitub is named once, in 1 Chronicles 8:11, as a son of Shaharaim by Hushim in the genealogy of Benjamin: 'And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.' He is one name in the Benjamite line, with no deed or story attached.
TheologicalSignificance: A single name in a genealogy is the whole record of Abitub, and it carries no teaching of its own. What it does tell me is that God's book keeps the small names: a son of Shaharaim, in the tribe of Benjamin, written down and never lost.
